title: Task Tracker
description: A comprehensive task tracking application for managing projects and to-do items. Features include task prioritization, deadline tracking, progress monitoring, and team collaboration capabilities.

title: Smart Farming Dashboard
description: An intelligent agricultural management system that provides real-time monitoring of crop health, soil conditions, and weather data. Includes analytics, predictive insights, and automated alerts for optimal farming decisions.

title: Marvel Studio
description: A creative studio platform for digital art and design collaboration. Features include project workspace management, real-time collaboration tools, asset library, and portfolio showcase capabilities.

title: E-Commerce Storefront
description: This is a simple e-commerce storefront built with static pages and JavaScript. It features a clean and responsive design, allowing users to browse products, view details, and add items to their cart. The project demonstrates basic e-commerce functionality without backend integration.
